steps.content: Contamination by the filth disintegrates and vanishes. The black raincoats fall to the ground crestfallenly. The battle is finally over, but Che doesn't wake up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How did he get so much contamination all over himself? Did he literally feed himself to Mania? Why did blondie do such a stupid thing? As far as I remember, he's a master of staying out of trouble.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Those men in raincoats can hunt down their enemies by recognizing Mania power. To mask our scent, Che buried himself in the contamination.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: He knew how to fool them. He knew the shackles could protect me. That's why he did such a foolish thing. Yet I know nothing...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Idiots... Both of them... Even now...

steps.speaker: Options
options: He wants to keep you safe.
Talk to him when he wakes up.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I'm no different. If anything happens to them, I...

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...He won't tell me anything. I need to find another way.
She closes her eyes and takes a deep breath. Once she calms down, she turns to face you.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Are you gonna use the shackles?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I'd like you to contain the contamination. Che is just a lazybones who likes slacking off. All he wants is to bask in the sun freely. If you must lock him up, just take me instead.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand. It's all just for containing the contamination.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: He's alright. He's only in this state because you kicked his soul out of him. Relax.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I owe him a lot. I can't repay him everything yet, so I won't take him for now.
It suffices just to be able to sense his location. You have a hunch that you'll need his help again in the future.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Now, can you tell me what happened here?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I have no idea either. But... Che wants me to relay a message.
